title: Anonymous model access corrected
summary:
Anonymous model access got sorted out, authenticated ad requests share less data, and model routing and image cache matching were tuned.

Unauthenticated requests now use the anonymous tier. `openai` is restored with GPT-4.1 Mini, while `openai-fast`, MIDIjourney, and Elixpo Search are available to anonymous users. Text requests now return 402 for insufficient access and 404 for unknown models; GPT Image requires the flower tier or higher.

Authenticated nex.ad requests no longer include the user's IP or fire impression URLs. Unauthenticated requests keep the existing behavior.

GPT-4.1 Mini requests can be distributed across six Azure Roblox endpoints. The image semantic cache now requires a closer match, and Azure resource parsing accepts both Cognitive Services and OpenAI endpoint domains.

highlights.title: More models without signing in
highlights.text: Anonymous requests can use `openai` with GPT-4.1 Mini, `openai-fast` with GPT-4.1 Nano, MIDIjourney, and Elixpo Search. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
